```python
def make_job(rng):
    seed = 'sd%d' % rng.randrange(100)
    nleases = rng.randrange(0,4)
    leases=[]
    bases=[]
    for i in range(nleases):

        if bases and rng.random()<0.4:
            base = bases[-1]   # overlap
            bits = 56
        else:

                       'start': rng.randrange(0,30), 'end': rng.randrange(60,120) if rng.random()<.2 else rng.randrange(500,1000),
                       'subnets': subnets, 'low_count': rng.randrange(1,4)})
```
